page.notes: Doubtful readings: the initial "S" of "Siquis" is a decorated letter and reads like I; marked [?]. "Feram" is printed with a letter resembling c. "sarcina" is printed with a long-s-like initial, read as s. "cremarctur" is uncertain, marked [?]. "tenebris" is partly covered by an ink blot, marked [?]. Printing errors left as printed: "Saint-dauberuille" and "Tretenesum" may be misprints. The initial "TEphanus" has a space after the large T in print, read as one word. The running head and the first heading carry the names in capitals, normalised u/v.
